name: popsicle
headline: Ethereal-mask-9914: Mailchimp Clone
short_description: Project to clone a website names mailchimp.com. Mailchimp is an American marketing automation platform and email marketing service for managing mailing lists and creating email marketing campaigns.
author: PRA3EEK

sections.overview:
Ethereal-mask-9914 is a functional clone of Mailchimp's website interface, showcasing core marketing automation platform features. It implements user account creation and login functionality using localStorage for session persistence, allowing users to register, authenticate, and access personalized dashboard features. The project demonstrates responsive navigation, form validation, and state management techniques relevant to email marketing and marketing automation platforms. Developers can study the codebase to understand how authentication flows and account management work in modern web applications.
Learning web authentication patterns with localStorage
Studying marketing platform UI/UX design implementation
Building account management features for email marketing tools
Understanding sign-up and login form workflows
This plan outlines the creation of a Mailchimp-like website for [COMPANY], a [INDUSTRY] business. The goal is to provide a modern, user-friendly platform for email campaign management, audience segmentation, and marketing automation.
